name: THRUSTER F CLAW
lines: The TK-F CLAW features the science-tested shaft and racket-frame configuration as in the TK-F that provides excellent resilience and maneuverability, capturing the essence of “precise attack” as when hawks hunt down the prey with their sharp claws.
Tai Tzu Ying will be debuting this latest power model in the new 2019 season.
[Face] Bigger head size, bigger sweet zone, and better maneuverability. The 72-hole design for fluid, solid hitting feel on the sweet spot.

In flat exchanges, the TK-F CLAW swings swift and bouncy with quick, high-efficiency energy transmission. In powerful strokes such as offensive clears and smashes, the solid feel when the shuttle makes contact with the racket-face can’t be any better with the sharper head shape and the 72-hole string pattern.
